references.text: Daniel 9:27 speaks of a covenant that is broken and an abomination of desolation that is set up, which mirrors what Jesus refers to in Mark 13:14.
Daniel 11:31 predicts that holy places will be desecrated and that an abomination of desolation will be set up, which parallels what Jesus describes in Mark 13:14.
Daniel 12:11 speaks of a time when the daily sacrifice is removed and an abomination of desolation is set up, which aligns with the events described in Mark 13:14.
Matthew 24:15 also refers to the abomination of desolation, which is a direct parallel to Mark 13:14.
